title: luzula campestris subsp. pulchella
intro: Luzula campestris subsp. pulchella, commonly known as the Wood Rush or Luzula, is a type of flowering plant belonging to the sedge family (Juncaceae). It is known for its potential health benefits, particularly in treating digestive issues, and is used to relieve symptoms of diarrhea and dysentery. The therapeutic actions of Luzula campestris subsp. pulchella include its anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic properties, which help to soothe the digestive system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, although further research is needed to fully understand its pharmacological properties.
